mapper.sql: chart_accounts.id AS id, chart_accounts.parent_id AS parentId, chart_account_parent.account_codes AS parentCode, (GREATEST(COALESCE(CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM chart_accounts.account_codes)) - 1, 0), 0) * 20) AS spacing, chart_account_parent.account_description AS parentDescription, chart_accounts.chart_account_type_id AS chartAccountTypeId, chart_account_types.name AS chartAccountTypeName, chart_accounts.chart_account_group_id AS chartAccountGroupId, chart_account_groups.name AS chartAccountGroupName, (SELECT branch_id FROM `chart_account_branches` WHERE `chart_account_id` = chart_accounts.id LIMIT 1) AS branchId, (SELECT name FROM branches WHERE id = (SELECT branch_id FROM `chart_account_branches` WHERE `chart_account_id` = chart_accounts.id LIMIT 1)) AS branchName, chart_accounts.account_codes AS accountCodes, chart_accounts.account_description AS accountDescription, chart_accounts.manual AS manual, chart_accounts.orcode AS orcode, chart_accounts.pvcode AS pvcode, chart_accounts.is_active AS status, DATE_FORMAT(chart_accounts.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(chart_accounts.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy

FROM chart_accounts LEFT JOIN chart_accounts AS chart_account_parent ON chart_account_parent.id = chart_accounts.parent_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = chart_accounts.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = chart_accounts.modified_by LEFT JOIN chart_account_types ON chart_account_types.id = chart_accounts.chart_account_type_id LEFT JOIN chart_account_groups ON chart_account_groups.id = chart_accounts.chart_account_group_id
mapper.select: SELECT companies.id AS id, companies.`name` AS name FROM companies INNER JOIN chart_account_companies ON chart_account_companies.company_id = companies.id WHERE companies.is_active = 1 AND chart_account_companies.chart_account_id = #{chartAccId}

SELECT branches.id AS id, branches.`name` AS name FROM branches INNER JOIN chart_account_branches ON chart_account_branches.branch_id = branches.id WHERE chart_account_branches.chart_account_id = #{chartAccId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chart_accounts( parent_id, chart_account_type_id, chart_account_group_id, apply_branch_type, account_codes, account_description, manual, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{chartOfAccount.parentId}, #{chartOfAccount.chartAccountTypeId}, #{chartOfAccount.chartAccountGroupId}, #{chartOfAccount.applyBranchType}, #{chartOfAccount.accountCodes}, #{chartOfAccount.accountDescription}, #{chartOfAccount.manual}, NOW(), #{chartOfAccount.createdBy}, #{chartOfAccount.isActive} );
mapper.update: UPDATE chart_accounts SET `parent_id` = #{chartOfAccount.parentId}, `chart_account_type_id` = #{chartOfAccount.chartAccountTypeId}, `chart_account_group_id` = #{chartOfAccount.chartAccountGroupId}, `account_codes` = #{chartOfAccount.accountCodes}, `account_description` = #{chartOfAccount.accountDescription}, `manual` = #{chartOfAccount.manual}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{chartOfAccount.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{chartOfAccount.id}
